senses.gloss:
Plīhā-karṇa as an epithet of cattle in the Yajurveda
Saṃhitās^1 probably denotes ‘having a spleen-shaped mark
branded on the ear,’ not as Mahīdhara in his commentary on
the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā^2 takes it, ‘having a disease called
Plīhan in the ear.’
1) Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 13, 5 (cf. iv. 2, 9); Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 24.
2) Loc. cit.
